description: An existential infinitary formula is true exactly when extending the current scoped assignment by some domain element makes its body true.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_ex.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} [Finite α]
  {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α (n + 1))
  (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ.ex a b ↔
    ∃ x, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ a (Fin.snoc b x)
